title: Leave with your data
summary: Delete your account on your terms, with time to export your data first.

highlights.title: Account deletion with export
highlights.body: Delete your account from Settings. You get a grace period to export your data, and you can resume or cancel the deletion.

items.text: Shared with me opens inside Chat in the desktop app.
